title: I4 Reproducible lab Lambda package build
description:
## Problem
The central lab stack cyclotron-console (infra/lab/template.yaml, PR #75) runs BffFunction and WorkerFunction (python3.13, x86_64) from one 28,939,467-byte zip at S3 key cyclotron-console/backend/<hash> (no .zip suffix) in the CDK bootstrap assets bucket of account 682849160744. Nothing in any repo records how that zip was built. A reproducible build is needed before any code deploy (which needs Ryan's separate approval).

## Scope
Read-only inventory of the deployed zip (no uploads or writes to AWS); scripts/dev/build_lab_package.sh with pinned deps; parity comparison; README recipe + deploy steps; optional LabCodeKey parameter if check_lab_template.sh still proves equivalence.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Cyclotron/pull/77. Deployed zip (sha256 b2a3bb38...793b6e, matches CodeSha256) = decision_flywheel 0.30.0 copied source matching commit 002e6f2, plus 42 pinned dists (accounts-cloud+jev closure, no boto3/uvicorn/dotenv), cp313/manylinux_2_34. Build from 002e6f2 via scripts/dev/build_lab_package.sh: same dist-info versions, byte-identical except trace-ui vendor bundles (deployed matches no commit), 2 held-out schema files only in build, REQUESTED markers, modes. Deterministic (2 builds, same sha256). make check exit 0 (2291 passed, trace-ui 269 passed). LabCodeKey not parameterized (snapshot check is literal). No AWS writes.
